subject.title: fix: fall back after replay-safe Bedrock prompt aborts

question: Should this Bedrock recovery fix require an observed abort-to-fallback trace, or may it merge on the focused regression coverage plus negative live Bedrock attempts when the provider abort cannot be reproduced in the available account and region?
rationale: The remaining blocker is evidence sufficiency rather than a mechanical code defect: the exact provider envelope is environment-dependent and the contributor has documented unsuccessful reproduction attempts.

options.title: Require direct recovery proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a reporter or production environment supplies a redacted after-fix trace showing replay-safe classification, fallback selection, and successful completion.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: Accept the focused regression tests and guarded implementation as sufficient if a maintainer judges the unavailable provider failure impractical to reproduce.

recommendation.title: Require direct recovery proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until a reporter or production environment supplies a redacted after-fix trace showing replay-safe classification, fallback selection, and successful completion.
